sections.title: Item 1. Business
sections.content:
ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Microsoft develops and supports software, services, devices, and solutions. Our three operating segments are Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Revenue increased $13.7 billion or 7% driven by growth in Intelligent Cloud and Productivity and Business Processes. Operating income increased 6% to $88,523 million.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
sections.content:

| Segment Revenue (in millions) | 2023 | 2022 |

| Productivity and Business Processes | $ 69,274 | $ 63,364 |

| Total Revenue | $ 211,915 | $ 198,194 |
| Operating income | $ 88,523 | $ 83,383 |
| Net income | $ 72,361 | $ 72,738 |
